subject: POC activation: Horizon AI — success criteria & responsibilities
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Tang <alyssa@horizon-ai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC activation: Horizon AI — success criteria & responsibilities

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC scheduled and responsibilities aligned.

Call highlights (summary):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Horizon AI production workload (chat + retrieval + embeddings).
- Primary success metrics you mentioned: latency, sustained throughput, and embedding quality.
- Key constraints: private VPC connectivity for data-in-place, SOC2 evidence, and a 3-week evaluation window.

Proposed POC success criteria (please confirm or adjust):
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for 512-token generation for the core chat route under expected traffic pattern.
2) Throughput: sustain 50 RPS across burst/steady mix for a 2-hour window without tail latency spikes.
3) Quality: retrieval+rerank embedding recall >= 0.88 on your labeled test set (we'll take your eval set).
4) Security/compliance: connectivity must be via your VPC peering and we must complete the security checklist before data onboarding.
5) Ops: automated logging of requests + per-token cost estimate in the dashboard.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Alyssa: confirm metrics above and share the evaluation set + point-of-contact for procurement (contract + SOW).
- Horizon procurement: provide any standard terms that would block a 3-week POC and procurement timeline.
- Marissa (cc): can you prep the infra checklist and a short network diagram (I attached a starting PNG)?
- Priyom (cc): can you draft a one-page activation runbook that lists what the customer engineers will need to supply (credentials, sample traffic, test queries)?

Suggested timeline (tentative):
- Day 0 (after SOW/POC sign): infra onboarding / VPC peering (2–3 business days)
- Day 3–5: model selection, perf baseline, warm caches
- Week 1–2: run evals, iterate prompts, measure metrics
- Week 3: final evaluation, handoff and decision meeting

Attachments: POC-success-metrics.xlsx (proposed metric sheet), redwood-network-requirements.png (network checklist stub).

If that all looks good I’ll propose two 60-minute slots tomorrow for a quick kickoff and get Marissa to draft the runbook.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: POC activation: Horizon AI — success criteria & responsibilities

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Quick confirmations and a couple of adjustments: 

1) Metrics: agree on the latency and throughput targets. For quality, can we set the initial pass threshold at recall >= 0.85 with a goal of >= 0.88 by week 2? We want to allow small tuning time.
2) Evaluation set: I’ll share a sanitized extract by EOD.
3) Procurement: adding Carlos (procurement) on this thread — Carlos, can you share the standard POC SOW and expected lead time? We prefer a POC engagement framework rather than a full contract for the evaluation period.
4) Security: we require an encrypted transit (mTLS) and SOC2 evidence before onboarding. Rishi from your team can coordinate if needed.

Timeline: a 3-week window is fine. We’d like an initial demo and smoke test within the first 5 business days.

Attaching: none on my side yet — will upload the eval set to the drive link provided.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Head of ML Ops, Horizon AI
alyssa@horizon-ai.com
